name: telmoni
description: Skills for working with Telmoni: the telmoni CLI, API keys and the read-only /v1 API, signed webhooks, and self-hosting with Docker Compose or Kubernetes.

interface.longDescription: Works with Telmoni, the platform for organizations and projects, members and roles, API keys, notifications and a hash-chained audit log. Drives the telmoni CLI, calls the read-only /v1 API with an API key, builds and tests receivers for Telmoni's signed webhooks, self-hosts Telmoni with Docker Compose or Kubernetes, and finds answers at docs.telmoni.com. The skill sends no data anywhere: it only reads Telmoni's public documentation.
defaultPrompt: Add a route to my app that receives and verifies Telmoni webhooks.
Sign my CI pipeline in to Telmoni with an API key and check it works.
Help me self-host Telmoni with Docker Compose.
